prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art prop atlas for an existing side-scrolling Sun Wukong Buddhist-ruins game, not a presentation board.
Input images: Image 1 mountain environment is a palette/material reference only. Image 2 existing lotus/lamps/gateway atlas is a scale-of-detail and carved-bronze reference only. Do not copy their layout or add background scenery.
Primary request: design the neglected playable map objects so they belong to the same weathered jade stone, oxidized bronze, vermilion cloth, warm lantern light world. Crisp authored pixel clusters, selective outlining, grouped highlights; texture and crafted silhouette, no simple flat UI pictograms.
Exact layout: square atlas, FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, twelve isolated sprites, all orthographic side-view. Every cell has generous transparent gutters, nothing overlaps adjacent cells. Feet/base centered at the same bottom baseline within each cell. No labels, no text, no grid, no shadows on a background. Actual alpha transparency.
Reading order:
ROW 1 four states of THE SAME small trial shrine: a weathered stone-and-bronze shrine with three upright miniature staves mounted beneath a broken curved lintel, loose red prayer ribbon and lotus-carved base. 1 ready: warm gold tips and unlit censer; 2 active: same silhouette with black-purple censer fire and red cloth tense; 3 challenge cleared: same shrine with clean pale jade bead light and three ivory staff tips; 4 claimed: same shrine, dim cold bronze, a lowered ribbon, no glow. These four must be registered at the exact same position and scale.
ROW 2: 1 a tall freestanding return-lantern shrine, carved lotus stone foot, slender bronze support, temple lantern cage and small warm amber wick, tiny red cord; 2 EXACT SAME return lantern after use, wick extinguished, cool grey amber glass, no light, identical size and base; 3 a small green jade medicinal gourd with ivory stopper and short vermilion tie, readily recognizable as a health pickup without a plus sign; 4 a turquoise concentration pearl nested in a small open bronze lotus, floating round pearl silhouette, clear pickup.
ROW 3: 1 a gold-red battle-spirit ember held in a tiny dark bronze claw, flame silhouette unlike the round turquoise pearl; 2 a low wide cluster of dormant cursed lotus thorns, closed charcoal stone petals and dull violet seams, no tall spikes; 3 SAME low wide thorn cluster warning state, petals beginning to open, rose-magenta edge light; 4 SAME low wide thorn cluster active, pointed black crystal lotus petals with rose-magenta inner facets, low wide continuous ground hazard. Hazard sprites are low and wide, not tall pillars; their top tips form a clear damage silhouette.
Composition: object silhouettes only. Trial shrines occupy approximately 75 percent cell height, lamps 75 percent height, tiny pickup objects approximately 40 percent height, hazard clusters approximately 25 percent height and 75 percent width. These differing relative sizes are intentional. Strong readable silhouette at 64px shrine height / 22px pickup height in the game.
Lighting: turquoise ambient shadow, restrained warm upper-left rim. Friendly light uses muted amber/jade. Danger only uses magenta-purple; don't use danger colour in the friendly lamp or pickups. Restrained warm metal, blue-grey carved rock and fabric colours from references. No soft bloom, gradients, modern UI icons, health crosses, lettering, characters, panels, ground scenery or isometric perspective.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent production terrain / traversal sprite atlas for a 2D side-scrolling pixel platform game.
Input images: Image 1 existing mountain environment, material / palette reference only. Image 2 newly designed shrines and pickups, shared art direction reference only.
Primary request: replace generic thin stone bars with thoughtfully authored terrain pieces in the same ruined Buddhist realm: weathered blue-grey carved stone, moss, aged bronze, dark waterlogged wood, restrained jade spiritual light. Crisp pixel clusters and carved detail matching the references, NOT painted concept art or UI.
Layout: FOUR columns by THREE rows, twelve separate cells on a square atlas. Each complete asset must stay INSIDE its own cell with at least 12 percent transparent margin. No asset crosses cells. Background is genuine alpha transparency, no labels or grid. Orthographic SIDE VIEW, no visible perspective top plane.
ROW 1: (1) a wide short mossy cliff-temple stone platform segment, worn lotus relief along its front, straight horizontal walkable upper edge; (2) a wide short ancient ferry boardwalk segment, dark wet timber, iron brackets and subtle rope lashings, same straight upper edge; (3) a wide short pale ash-grey monastery stone cornice, worn cloud relief and tarnished bronze seams, same upper edge; (4) a wide short fragile stone slab, exposed split joints, barely joined segments and hanging broken supports, unmistakably less stable than the intact slabs, straight walkable upper edge.
ROW 2: (1) EXACT SAME fragile slab in cracking state, same size / position / intact outer footprint, deeper branching cracks and tiny falling chips, restrained amber crack edges, no big explosion; (2) a wide short movable ferry raft, bound parallel bamboo and dark wooden deck, rope end ties, two small bronze rings, straight upper deck surface; (3) an unpowered magical bridge segment, three separated dim blue-grey carved stones with visibly missing joints, NO continuous walkable line and no glow; (4) EXACT SAME bridge segment powered, stones aligned to one continuous horizontal surface, jade light ONLY in narrow joints and lotus carving, not a neon rectangle.
ROW 3: (1) a rectangular repeatable wall-fill texture patch of dark cliff masonry, blue-grey rough blocks, moss seams and small chipped edges, no frame, uniform across its edges; (2) a rectangular repeatable dark ferry-foundation patch of damp stone piers and muted wooden braces, subdued specular flecks, no water scenery, no frame; (3) a rectangular repeatable monastery-foundation patch, ash-dark stone blocks with weathered relief and cracks, no frame; (4) a slender weathered bronze-and-charcoal lotus boundary pillar, layered lotus stone foot and a small three-petal magenta crystal at its top, a threatening arena threshold marker, no full doorway.
Composition: terrain segments in rows 1 and 2 should be approximately 75 percent CELL WIDTH and 25 percent CELL HEIGHT; their straight upper edge is unbroken except the unpowered bridge. Texture patches use 75 percent width and 55 percent height, deliberately darker and lower contrast than platforms. The pillar is tall/slender, about 70 percent cell height.
Constraints: physical material silhouettes and sculpted details at real game scale, not flat rectangles with geometric stripes. Do not add grass or spikes above walkable edges. No characters, UI, lettering, full environment, blurred glow, isometric view, anti-aliased painted edges, dramatic cast shadows. Keep transparent margins and exact order.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent map-dressing atlas for the existing 2D Sun Wukong pixel platform game.
Input images: Image 1 mountain background and Image 2 new shrine/lantern atlas are STYLE AND MATERIAL references only. Match their weathered Chinese Buddhist architecture and crisp pixel clusters. These are low-contrast environmental props, NOT interactable rewards.
Primary request: give the existing extended map routes distinct local identity with small grounded environment groupings. No new game objects or mechanics. NO glow, no bright pickup gems, no signs to read, no characters.
Exact layout: THREE columns and TWO rows, SIX complete isolated side-view environment sprites on transparent canvas. Equal cells with generous alpha gutters, no cropping, nothing crossing cell boundaries. Each group has a coherent single ground baseline, no horizon or background. No grid, labels, letters, watermark, cast shadows or presentation frame.
Reading order:
ROW 1 (1) mountain trail: a low weathered stone prayer stupa, chipped lotus relief, twisted exposed pine roots around its base, sparse desaturated moss and one small faded red ribbon; (2) ancient ferry: a broken old wooden mooring frame with two bound posts, a coiled thick rope, an empty extinguished lantern cage and river-worn stones; (3) monastery courtyard: two broken Buddhist memorial steles leaning together, a shallow bronze incense bowl with cold grey ash and a few withered leaves, carved cloud motifs without readable writing.
ROW 2 (1) mountain trail: a low cluster of fallen carved stone blocks and a dry bowed pine branch, tiny moss accents and faded prayer cloth caught on one end; (2) ancient ferry: a low pile of water-dark broken planks, a split bronze mooring ring, knotted rope and a small cracked unlit stone lantern; (3) monastery courtyard: a collapsed incense altar with chipped lotus stone feet, a broken bronze urn and scattered small pale stone fragments, no fire.
Composition: each is a compact silhouette that reads at about 80-110 pixels WIDE and 55-80 pixels TALL in the game; do not make tall trees or imposing background buildings. Strong grouping, readable worn materials, no fussy scattered objects. Restrained jade-grey, dark timber, tarnished bronze and muted vermilion. Darker/lower contrast than characters, danger cues, pickups and the friendly lamp.
Style: authored pixel-art textures with hard pixel stepping, no soft painted gradients, no modern vector icons, no isometric floor, no perspective top-down scene. Genuine alpha background, no white or black background painted in.

normalization: tools/prepare-map-art.py; no colour key or painted replacement
